cross_division_ui.title: Cross-Division Tasks
cross_division_ui.load_failed: Failed to load cross-division data. Try reloading the page.
cross_division_ui.sent_message: The request was forwarded to the target division.
cross_division_ui.intro: Work that starts in your division but must be done by another division is sent through this page. The request lands in the target division's inbox (Intake), and that division's admin decides whether to accept or decline. You don't get access to the target division's content, and vice versa.
cross_division_ui.stat_waiting_hint: sent by my origin division, not yet decided
cross_division_ui.summary_note: The first two numbers count every request sent by your origin division (the summary endpoint only opens divisions you belong to). The table below only shows requests you sent yourself.
cross_division_ui.no_origin: You aren't a member of any division in this workspace, so there is no origin division you can file from. Ask an admin to add you to your division first.
cross_division_ui.no_targets: No division can receive requests yet. Only divisions that have turned on Intake appear here, and turning it on is that division's own decision, not something that can be switched on from this page. Contact the target division's admin and ask them to enable Inbox/Intake in their project settings.
cross_division_ui.origin_hint: Only divisions you are a member of.
cross_division_ui.target_hint: Only divisions that have turned on Intake.
cross_division_ui.request_title_placeholder: e.g. Prepare the tender document account
cross_division_ui.note_placeholder: Short context: what is needed, for what, by when.
cross_division_ui.description_placeholder: Steps or materials that need to be prepared.
cross_division_ui.description_hint: Sent as plain text (no HTML formatting). A blank line becomes a new paragraph.
cross_division_ui.visibility_hint: Your title and note are visible to the target division. The rest of your division's content is not.
cross_division_ui.no_requests: You haven't sent any requests yet. Sent requests will show up here along with their status in the target division.
cross_division_ui.footer_note: The task status in the target division is only shown coarsely (open / done / won't do). Who works on it, due dates, labels and comments are not exposed through this page.
